caption:
Missed calls were never free.

Starting October 1, 2026, Google can bill you for a missed Local Service Ads call if the caller stays on the line past 20 seconds, even when nobody picks up.

That's an old cost showing up on a new invoice.

Most shops already lose the job the moment a call rings out. Only 17% of service businesses answer a new lead within the first hour, and callers who reach a human inside 5 minutes close at roughly double everyone else's rate.

Google now keeps score on a cost you were already paying.

See it answered automatically, 14 days free.

rationale: Bold-claim to-camera reels win hook rate for B2B right now, and Google's October 1, 2026 LSA missed-call billing change gives a genuinely fresh, verifiable hook for a contrarian POV distinct from every prior ads-vs-systems, leak, booking-friction, and cost-per-lead take.
